from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
read=lambda p:json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
write=lambda name,data:(root/name).write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
dependency=root.parent/'material-soft-objective-v1'
assert read(dependency/'state.json')['status']=='complete'
assert not (root/'state.json').exists()
inputs=read(root/'inputs.json')
pins=read(dependency/'source.json');pins.update(inputs['sourceHashes'])
for p in [root/'inputs.json',root/'preflight.mjs',root/'run.py',root/'after-soft.py',Path('scripts/inverse/hard-photo-benchmark.mjs'),Path('scripts/inverse/hard-photo-target.mjs'),Path('scripts/inverse/hard-photo-data.mjs')]:pins[str(p)]=sha(p)
write('source.json',pins)
def verify():
    for p,h in pins.items():assert sha(p)==h,p
def execute(name,command,completed):
    verify()
    with (root/(name+'.log')).open('w')as log:
        p=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        write('state.json',dict(status='running',stage=name,controllerPid=os.getpid(),pid=p.pid,completed=completed,total=4))
        code=p.wait()
    verify()
    if code:
        write('state.json',dict(status='failed',stage=name,exitCode=code));raise SystemExit(code)

started=time.monotonic();execute('preflight',['node',str(root/'preflight.mjs')],0)
preflight=read(root/'preflight.json');assert preflight['status']=='passed'
rows=inputs['rows'][:2]+list(reversed(inputs['rows'][2:]));results=[]
for row in rows:
    name=row['id']+'-'+row['variant'];output=root/name
    execute(name,['node','scripts/inverse/hard-photo-benchmark.mjs','--ids='+row['id'],'--crop=fixed','--crop-overrides='+row['override'],'--target=mask','--seconds=10','--presets=automatic','--output='+str(output)],len(results))
    result=read(output/'results.json')['results'][0]
    assert result['id']==row['id']
    assert max(abs(a-b) for p,q in zip(result['effectiveQuad'],row['quad']) for a,b in zip(p,q))<1e-9
    run=result['runs'][0]
    assert run['settings']==row['settings'],'Keep all fitting settings fixed.'
    expected=next(p for p in preflight['results']if p['id']==row['id']and p['variant']==row['variant'])
    assert run['fittingMaskSha256']==expected['maskSha256']
    assert run['observation'].get('sha256')==expected['validSha256']
    results.append(dict(id=row['id'],variant=row['variant'],status=result['status'],passed=run['passed'],
        maskSha256=run['fittingMaskSha256'],observedFraction=run['observation']['observedPixels']/run['observation']['totalPixels'],
        seconds=run.get('solveAndValidationSeconds'),independentError=run.get('independentImageComparison'),
        features=run.get('independentFeatures'),selectedCounts=run.get('report',{}).get('solver',{}).get('selectedCounts'),
        report=str(output/'results.json')))
    write('results.json',dict(status='running',results=results));print(name,result['status'],flush=True)
verify();write('results.json',dict(status='complete',results=results))
write('state.json',dict(status='complete',seconds=time.monotonic()-started,sourceFilesVerified=len(pins)))
scriptSnapshots.after-soft.py:
from pathlib import Path
import json,os,subprocess,time

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
dependency=root.parent/'material-soft-objective-v1'
read=lambda p:json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
write=lambda data:(root/'dependency-state.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
assert not (root/'dependency-state.json').exists()
while True:
    p=dependency/'state.json'
    state=read(p)if p.exists()else read(dependency/'dependency-state.json')
    if state['status']=='complete'and p.exists():break
    if state['status']not in ['running','waiting']:
        write(dict(status='dependency-failed',dependency=state));raise SystemExit(1)
    pid=state['controllerPid']
    try:os.kill(pid,0)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        if p.exists()and read(p)['status']=='complete':break
        write(dict(status='dependency-handle-missing',dependency=state));raise SystemExit(1)
    write(dict(status='waiting',controllerPid=os.getpid(),dependencyPid=pid,dependencyStage=state.get('id',state.get('dependencyStage'))))
    time.sleep(5)
with (root/'controller.log').open('w')as log:
    p=subprocess.Popen(['python3',str(root/'run.py')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    write(dict(status='running',controllerPid=os.getpid(),pid=p.pid));code=p.wait()
write(dict(status='complete'if code==0 else'failed',exitCode=code));raise SystemExit(code)
